title: Assume Mode
style: Future bass with new jazz chords, skittering syncopated drums, and half-time drops; verse stays tight with dry keys and clipped percussion, pre-chorus opens into airy vocal stacks, chorus hits with wide saw blooms and octave bass movement. Lead vocal is close-mic and urgent, with doubled hooks and playful ad-libs. Filter sweeps, reversed swells, and glitchy fills bridge sections; bright, glossy, punchy mix., jazz, breaks
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
No menu loop, no stall tonight
Short words, hard facts, keep the line tight
If it breaks we log, if it works we ship
No drift pattern, no lost grip

[Pre-Chorus]
Assume sometimes
Unless you ask
I guess we all
Have to assume that

[Chorus]
Assume mode, no ask
Build it now, lock it down
Hands to keys till the board is filled
One step done, next step real

Assume mode, no stop
Yeah, no stop, let me hear what you got
Proof on disk, that is the deal
Safe and sound, let me hear it now

[Verse 2]
Ok hold up, it's not all luck
We all go this thing, let me make it ring
You can look, read ya book
Go on then, have a good look again

You can tell you
What you want to
You can believe too
If you want to

You really want to know?
Think like that, yeah like that
Enough with the text
Emotion less comments

[Pre-Chorus]
No dislikes
I like
No dislikes
No dislikes

[Chorus]
Assume mode, no ask
Build it now, lock it down
Hands to keys till the board is filled
One step done, next step real

Assume mode, no stop
Yeah, no stop, let me hear what you got
Proof on disk, that is the deal
Safe and sound, let me hear it now

[Bridge]
We ain't going to roll like that
Stat, stat, stat
Sing it back
From your chest to my content

Like a pen pal
My song pal
Assume that we do not assume
But we have to

[Outro]
Assume mode stays
No stall phrase
Build it now
Lock it down

Yeah, no stop, let me hear what you got
For me to hear safe and sound
